meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 渲染动画视频并生成配音
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常做动画短视频，需要批量渲染并加配音。
copy.tagline_en: Render animated videos and generate voiceover
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly make animated short videos and need batch rendering with voiceover.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 HyperFrames 命令行工具帮你做视频项目:创建项目、搜索动效组件、做质量检查、预览,并把画面渲染成 MP4 视频;也能通过云端或无服务器服务渲染,同时用于诊断构建或渲染失败。
howto.when: 当用户要求用 HyperFrames 做视频(搭建、预览、渲染等),或要诊断构建/渲染失败时触发;覆盖本地、云、AWS Lambda 等渲染平台。

say.text: 初始化一个 HyperFrames 项目
say.note: 执行 init 并生成项目骨架

say.text: 搜索“一行一行揭示标题”的动效
say.note: 查询本地目录,返回匹配动效

say.text: 检查并把这个项目渲染成高清 MP4
say.note: 先检查再渲染,产出高清 MP4

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude uses the HyperFrames CLI for video projects: scaffolding, searching motion presets, quality checks, preview, and rendering MP4s, locally or via cloud/serverless. Also used to diagnose build or render failures.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to work on a HyperFrames video project (scaffold, preview, render) or to diagnose build/render failures. Covers local, HeyGen cloud, AWS Lambda, etc.

say_en.note: Runs init to scaffold the project.

say_en.text: Search for a motion preset that reveals a headline line by line.
say_en.note: Queries the local catalog for matching primitives.

say_en.text: Check this project and render it as a high-quality MP4.
say_en.note: Runs check then render with high quality.
